contract_title: IT Services and Supply Agreement (version 2, Contractor's markup)
parties: Pak Telecom Enterprises (Pvt) Ltd, Islamabad (the Client)
M/s Indus Infotech Solutions (Pvt) Ltd, Karachi (the Contractor)
note: Synthetic contract written for this project (Day 4, Task 3): the Contractor's markup of version 1. Planted changes: payment 30->60 days + late interest; confidentiality 7->2 years + subcontractor disclosure; mutual indemnity; one-sided liability cap; auto-renewal with short notice; termination for convenience removed and given to the Contractor; non-solicitation replaced by a 3-year non-compete on the Client; Dubai courts; one stylistic rewording (clause 2) with no legal effect.

clauses.text: WHEREAS the Client desires to procure specialized engineering and information technology services, and the Contractor represents that it possesses the requisite expertise, equipment and personnel to deliver the same under Pakistani regulatory standards.

The Contractor shall perform the tasks set out in Schedule A in compliance with Pakistani technical standards, ISO certifications and applicable guidelines, and shall assign only qualified personnel approved by the Client.

This Agreement shall commence on 1 February 2024 and continue for one (1) year, and shall thereafter renew automatically for successive terms of three (3) years unless either Party gives written notice of non-renewal at least fifteen (15) days before the end of the then-current term.

Invoices shall be submitted monthly and paid within sixty (60) days in Pakistani Rupees (PKR). Overdue amounts shall carry interest at two percent (2%) per month. Payments shall be subject to deduction of applicable withholding income tax under the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001 and provincial sales tax on services, and the Client shall provide tax deduction certificates.

Both Parties shall protect all business proprietary secrets and customer data of the other Party. Neither Party shall disclose confidential materials to any third party without prior written consent, provided that the Contractor may disclose such materials to its subcontractors and affiliates. This obligation survives termination for two (2) years.

Each Party shall indemnify and hold harmless the other Party against any third-party claims arising from its negligence, wilful misconduct or infringement of intellectual property rights. The Client shall further indemnify the Contractor against all claims arising from the Client's use of the deliverables.

The Contractor's aggregate liability under this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid in the one (1) month preceding the claim. The Contractor shall not be liable for indirect or consequential loss.

Either Party may terminate this Agreement if the other Party commits a material breach and fails to remedy it within ninety (90) days of written notice. The Contractor may terminate this Agreement for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice.
During the term and for three (3) years thereafter, the Client shall not engage any other provider of information technology services in Pakistan without the Contractor's prior written consent.

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan. The courts of Dubai, United Arab Emirates shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of or in connection with this Agreement.
